metadata.description: Small Claude Code mods: a creation log, an edit diff log, and table export buttons

plugins.name: creation-log
plugins.description: Pane listing files and links Claude created (new files, gh create URLs, published Artifacts)

plugins.name: edit-diff-log
plugins.description: Pane listing every file edit Claude made, each with its unified diff, kept across sessions

plugins.name: table-export
plugins.description: Buttons under Claude's replies that copy each markdown table as TSV or save it as CSV in ~/Downloads
